name: sonarqube-cloud-mcp-server
title: SonarQube Cloud
summary: Explore SonarQube Cloud projects, code quality and security issues, quality gates, and measures from AI assistants.
description: The hosted SonarQube Cloud MCP service lets AI assistants retrieve existing code quality and security information from projects accessible to the signed-in user. Discover organizations and projects, investigate issues and rules, explain quality gate failures, and inspect measures such as coverage. Connect over Streamable HTTP using OAuth or a SonarQube Cloud user token. This entry uses the EU endpoint; US-region setup is documented in the linked guide. Use of the hosted service is subject to SonarQube Cloud terms of service.

useCases.name: Discover accessible projects
useCases.description: List organizations and projects available to the signed-in user to establish the context for code quality investigations.

useCases.name: Explain quality gate failures
useCases.description: Retrieve quality gate status and related measures to understand why an existing project fails its quality gate.

useCases.name: Investigate code quality and security issues
useCases.description: Explore existing project issues and rule details to understand findings and plan remediation.

useCases.name: Inspect coverage and project measures
useCases.description: Retrieve measures such as coverage to identify areas that need further investigation.

sonarqubeCloudOAuth.description: OAuth authorization code flow with PKCE. Scopes control tool access, subject to the user's SonarQube Cloud permissions.

sonarqubeCloudUserToken.description: A SonarQube Cloud user token sent in the Authorization header using the Bearer scheme.
